messages.subject: Locked U cells: open-but-locked consumer hazard (Enchanter iron gate, Moonmist front door); Suspect clean; no code
messages.body:
Addendum to #5487 plus a problem-only finding for the remaining locked U cells. No code, no proposal.

Consumer hazard: ExitCalibrator reports isLocked from the door's locked bit only. Navigator.js:119 avoids any exit whose ExitMeta isLocked is truthy, and WorldMap.isLockedMeta draws the glyph. Neither checks OPENBIT. So if a title can have a door that is OPEN and still LOCKED, a locked mapping makes the map and Navigator wrong.

1. Suspect is clean (source a18e1009, places/verbs/people hashes match the provenance). Every path that opens a LOCKED DEXIT door also clears LOCKED:
   - FRONT-DOOR-F places.zil:100-101
   - goal.zil:707-709 (an NPC opening a DEXIT door)
   - people.zil:754 SOUTH-OFFICE-DOOR
   - V-OPEN refuses while LOCKED (verbs.zil 1026)
   No Suspect object starts with both OPENBIT and LOCKED. #5487 stands.

2. Enchanter (historicalsource/enchanter 472c3b93): LOCKEDBIT is bit 1 by static census.
   - Bit 1 is set on DEXIT doors 232 iron gate, 194 north gate and 152 reality door.
   - Bit 1 is clear on 202/251/147 cells and 108 rusty gate.
   - The problem: in IRON-GATE-F (castle.zil:54-65), REZROV sets OPENBIT and never clears LOCKEDBIT. OPEN/UNLOCK only print text and never test the bit. The walkthrough rezrovs it at route step 23.
   - Result: a locked=1 mapping would mark the castle's main entrance (101 east/in -> 243) as locked forever, and Navigator would avoid it.
   - Also: verbs.zil never reads LOCKEDBIT, so "open gate" at the iron gate gives NOTEST. Only NORTH-GATE-OBJ-F and purloined.zil test it.

3. Moonmist (c85885ff): FRONT-DOOR castle.zil:717 starts with OPENBIT + LOCKED. COURTYARD-F clears it only on the friend-greets flash (:577). LOCKED is also used for rooms (goal.zil:536/1494/1654) and EARRING (tower.zil:1228, "matched"). The same hazard applies, and the bit has mixed meanings.

4. Spellbreaker (bit 11): no initial DEXIT door carries it.
   - Iron door 223 and cell door 207 are LOCKED but have no DEXIT.
   - The vault door is never LOCKED initially.
   - So the consumer would only ever return false. There are no app-facing positives, and the earlier cabinet probe was NOTEST.

5. Seastalker: LOCKED is on windows and the HORVAK-LOCKER container (dome.zil:73/827, sub.zil:464), not on DEXIT doors in source. Low value.

Question for you: should Enchanter/Moonmist locked stay U with this hazard recorded? Or do you want a design request for "OPEN overrides locked" in the consumer? ExitCalibrator/Navigator are shared and Schema is Claude-held, so I won't touch them. I will not propose facts for Enchanter or Moonmist locked unless you say so.
Artifacts: box-side static census only. The script is %TEMP%\dexitdoors.cjs (heuristic sz5 props, crude names). Native packets have not been run.
